results.note: ČTK (12 Nov 18:31) reports Babiš met Zelensky in Dublin on the sidelines of the EPC summit, and Ukrinform (12 Nov) reports Zelensky's meetings with Costa, von der Leyen and Rutte in Dublin.

Ukrinform (12 Nov 08:35 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 11 Nov Russia launched 123 attack drones (73 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, Banderol/Dan-T, Parodiya) plus ballistic and Zircon missiles, below 180.
ČTK (12 Nov) quotes Babiš speaking to reporters on arrival at the EPC summit in Dublin and reports his bilateral with Zelensky on the summit sidelines that day.

ČT24 (11 Nov, updated 21:17) reports the three leaders only presented the coalition, with the coalition agreement to be ready before the 19 Nov assembly; no signing on 11 or 12 Nov is reported by ČTK or ČT24 (ČT24's Scheinherr topic page has no later item).
ČT24 (11 Nov) reports the coalition will announce the composition of the council next week before the assembly session; only some names circulated via iDNES, not all 11 attributed to the coalition.
ČTK (12 Nov 14:12), citing the Finance Ministry's Cenový věstník issued that day, reports the Friday 13 Nov diesel cap cut by 38 haléřů to 45.49 CZK/l (petrol 40.65).
ONS first quarterly estimate (12 Nov 2026): UK real GDP is estimated to have increased by 0.7% in Q3 (Jul-Sep) 2026, after 0.5% in Q2.
The Tweede Kamer bill page for 37022 records the final vote (Stemmingen 21:05-21:15) as 'Aangenomen (76-74)', and NOS ('Belastingplan aangenomen', 12 Nov 22:50) confirms adoption on 12 Nov.
The bill was adopted on 12 Nov by 76 votes to 74, fewer than the 85 required.

ČTK (12 Nov, 07:04), reporting ČEZ's Q1-Q3 2026 results, gives adjusted net profit (čistý zisk očištěný) of CZK 26.3bn for January-September, up 19% (reported net profit CZK 26.6bn); cez.cz did not render for the reader.

ČTK (12 Nov) reports ČEZ raised its full-year 2026 net-profit outlook to CZK 34-37bn (from 31-35bn; ČEZ's net-profit guidance is the adjusted measure), so the upper bound is above the old range and neither bound is below it; the EBITDA outlook was left at CZK 109-114bn.
